distribution.narrative: Yin et al. (1984) documented three separately published name usages now crosswalked to this taxon. Under Polygraphus squameus, the source lists Qinghai (Yushu); Sichuan (Chengdu, Miyaluo, Maerkang); Yunnan (Zhongdian, Lijiang); and Xizang (Changdu, Basu, Chayu, Bomi, Milin, Linzhi, Gongbojiangda, Jilong). Under Polygraphus zhungdianensis, it lists Sichuan (Kangding); Yunnan (Zhongdian); and Xizang (Bomi, Linzhi, Cuona, Yadong, Jilong). Under Polygraphus rudis, it lists Sichuan (Miyaluo, Songgang, Mount Emei, Ebian, Kangding) and Yunnan (Lijiang). Huang & Lu (2015) list Guizhou, Yunnan, and Xizang under Polygraphus rudis rudis. These historical records are mapped through the taxonomic backbone; their subspecific assignments and occurrences have not been independently verified. Mainland China remains Candidate.
